items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: this alto player that used to be with Lenny Tristano

ctx.x: Well, I had played with white musicians, you know, all through those years, you know, but...I played with this alto...um... this clarinet player that died, he used to be with Hamp, oh what was his name...anyway, I played with him at the Apollo Theater. And then, you know,

Zoot and I and Al Cohn and this alto player that used to be with Lenny Tristano. You know, we were all friends, you know, and we'd jam on 52nd Street and I knew the guys all through the years, but this was the first actual situation where I was exposed to a whole new facet of the music business. And there was one other colored fellow who knew all the music. He'd sing in Yiddish and do everything. His name was Bill Dillard and he was also an actor--but he was a top man. And we became friends, you know. But he and…
put on a show, you know.
